refinement_actions_definition: D1/D2/D3 midpoint-hierarchy SCAN actions; D0 fixed-grid SCAN is reported separately
VERIFY_admitted: equal to completed physical_VERIFY_calls per run
VERIFY_rejected: one fail-closed post-action admission attempt per run when stop_reason begins verify_not_admitted
scheduler_overhead_seconds: UNAVAILABLE: inherited physical runner does not separately timestamp the sandbox policy RPC; not reported as zero
snapshot_commit_seconds: Measured per run as sum(checkpoint_elapsed - physical_action_end); see METHOD_DEADLINE_METRICS.csv
interpretation: D3 failure cannot be attributed to less work: every D3 formal run completed 29 scans and five VERIFY calls.
